---
type: bigtable
title: Distinct type that collides after normalization
description: Already-normalized "bigtable" — a different original type than "Big %// Table".
---

This concept's `type` is literally `bigtable`. Because [bigtable_a](/concepts/bigtable_a.md)
already claimed the `bigtable` table name, this distinct type is routed to `bigtable_2` and a
collision warning is emitted.
